QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Mushking's Summons
QuestInfo.0: You've received an invitation letter from the Mushking. Check it out.
QuestInfo.1:
The Mushroom Castle is opening its doors back up, and you have been invited to investigate an important matter. The picture included puts you a little ill at ease about the whole thing...

#rTip. Double-click the Mushking's Summons item to teleport to the Mushroom Castle entrance.#k
QuestInfo.2: The Mushking has invited you to an event involving his beautiful (?) Princess Violetta.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: #questorder1#Go to the Mushroom Castle Banquet Hall (#R30050ExRef30050#)\r\n

0.conditionContent: Go to the Mushroom Castle Banquet Hall

0.msg: My dear #h0#,\r\n\r\nHow does my letter find you? I am the Mushking, king of the Mushking Empire. As you are probably aware, our doors have been closed to foreigners for some time. We have been working on repairing the castle and strengthening our walls.

1.msg: At last, I would like to re-open the gates of the castle. The repairs aren't complete, but #rsomething important#k has come up and we'd like to bring the public in. To give you an idea of this important matter...

2.msg: Why don't you check it out yourself? I will say that it's about my stunningly beautiful daughter, #bPrincess Violetta#k. I am also attaching a picture, in case you don't remember what she looks like. \r\n#fEffect/Direction2.img/effect/flowervioleta/quest/1/0#

3.msg: (This invitation may be a trap, trying to get you into picking a fight with them. There's something... ominous about this letter. Either way, you should go check it out yourself.)

0.msg: I guess it's not a bad idea to pay a visit.  And this important matter regarding the hideo... er, VERY unique princess.\r\n#rTip. Double-click the Mushking's Summons item to teleport to the Mushroom Castle entrance.#k\r\n
Yeah, this can't be an actual friendly invitation. That picture... Aagh, my eyes! Let me just forget I ever saw that.
